definition.label: Meaningful activity days
definition.description: Tenant shows repeated operational activity across six or more days in the last 30 days.
definition.rationale: Repeated activity is stronger than one-time setup completion.

definition.label: Active weeks trailing 8
definition.description: Tenant is active in at least five of the last eight weeks.
definition.rationale: Habitual weekly operations are usually the clearest signal of embedded workflow value.

definition.label: Monthly order cadence
definition.description: Tenant sustains at least eight order events in the current month.
definition.rationale: Order throughput is the most direct signal of recurring operational value for Arda.

definition.label: Recent activity vs baseline
definition.description: Current activity stays above 70% of the trailing baseline.
definition.rationale: Current-month collapse is more actionable than historical average usage.

definition.label: Time to first order
definition.description: Tenant places its first meaningful order within 21 days of go-live.
definition.rationale: Early value realization is the cleanest onboarding-stage proxy for future retention.
